title: Grilled Chicken with Chinese Flair
description: A simple and flavorful dish that combines the taste of Chinese cuisine with the char of a grilled chicken.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce, honey, five-spice powder, and grill seasoning.
Add the chicken to the bowl and coat evenly with the marinade.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped green onions and serve immediately.
